item.title: Olympic buzz draws skaters to Arkansas Skatium
item.description: As international competition shines a spotlight on winter sports, more Arkansans are heading to the rink to try skating for themselves.

item.title: Little Rock small business owner expects to feel ripple effects of back and forth on tariffs
item.description: A U.S. Supreme Court decision striking down many of President Donald Trump’s sweeping global tariffs is creating fresh uncertainty for small businesses in Arkansas, including one Little Rock pottery studio that relies on imported materials.

item.title: Pine Bluff shooting on Friday night leaves 1 dead, 2 injured
item.description: Pine Bluff police are investigating after a Friday night shooting left one person dead and two others injured.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Cold Nights Ahead
item.description: We’re beginning to clear out across much of the state as we head through this evening, with mostly clear skies statewide tonight and into early tomorrow morning. Clear conditions stick around through the rest of the weekend, along with a northerly wind that’s going to help temperatures drop quickly.

item.title: Texarkana pastor arrested on five counts of rape
item.description: Cedric Monteze Sharp, 51, pastor of Bright Star Missionary Baptist Church in Texarkana, was arrested on five counts of rape and released with court-imposed restrictions.

item.title: Arkansas Storm Team Forecast: Cold start, then wildfire danger returns
item.description: Monday morning is cold across Arkansas, feeling even colder with a bit of windchill. Tuesday morning is cold again, then temperatures warm up into the low 60s Tuesday afternoon with plummeting relative humidity values and blustery conditions. That means the risk for wildfire danger returns on Tuesday. Our next chance for rain comes Wednesday night into Thursday, but overall totals will be light.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.
